Download the closed trades of a project in the date range provided. The /live/export/trades API accepts requests in the following format:

ExportLiveTradesRequest Model - Request to download the closed trades of the live deployments of a project.
projectId integer
required
example: 23456789
Id of the project from which to download the closed trades.
start integer
example: 1727222400
Earliest entry time of the trades in Unix time (seconds). The default value is one hour before the first deployment of the project.
end integer
example: 1792022400
Latest exit time of the trades in Unix time (seconds). The default value is the current time.
Example 
{
  "projectId": 23456789,
  "start": 1727222400,
  "end": 1792022400
}
